newsitem.title: UK: Fleming Cont borrows for Europe investment.
newsitem.headline: Fleming Cont borrows for Europe investment.

text.p: The Fleming Continental European Investment Trust plc said on Friday it would borrow the equivalent of 50 million sterling at fixed rates from Robert Fleming & Co to invest in continental European markets.
The five year loan will be made in three European currencies, French franc, mark and Swiss franc, a spokeswoman said.
The company would not detail what rates would be charged.

The Association of Investment Trust companies said that at February 28, the trust had total assets of 298 million stg, with 23 percent in France, 18 percent in Switzerland, 15 in Germany, 10 in the Netherlands, six percent in the UK and 28 percent in other countries.

"The directors believe that the rationale for investing in continental European markets remains strong and are confident that the returns available from these markets in the period of the loan will exceed the cost of borrowing," Fleming Continental said in a statement.
Company policy emphasises capital growth with the level of dividend of secondary importance.
"As a result of entering into this agreement, it is likely that the level of dividend may in future years be lower than has historically been paid."
It said it expected the agreement to be beneficial to the long term interests of shareholders.
